name: amartha-bagarry
description: Papan pengumuman dan kas cluster Amartha Bagarry (Cloudflare Worker + D1 + R2)

scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply bagarry-db-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute bagarry-db --local --file=seed/example-houses.sql && wrangler d1 execute bagarry-db --local --file=seed/example-accounts.sql
scripts.db:seed:staging: wrangler d1 execute bagarry-db-staging --env staging --remote --file=seed/example-houses.sql && wrangler d1 execute bagarry-db-staging --env staging --remote --file=seed/example-accounts.sql
